title: Umbel person decision, version 2
description: Version 1 (phase 5 section 7.2, D115) with what the Ideas host-review specification adds (sections 3, 4 and 6, D180): pages, each page of a paged preview the page rendered, with the SHA-256 of what it showed and the ids of its items; excluded, the item ids the person unchecked before confirming, final on Approve and told to the run, never part of the input or its digest; and the level local, a decision on the local person page served on a loopback address with no login, which records no authTime or acr and is for the local person (namespace local, no issuer, no client). A decision's expiry moves to each render's time plus person.decision_ttl_s, at most 24 hours after createdAt. A version 1 row reads as version 2 with no pages and nothing excluded. One decision a person makes on the person page, in state/shared/person.sqlite3 (phase 5 section 7.2, D115). HumanRelay::begin over MCP, or the CLI, writes it pending; the page records the decision after a fresh login with user verification whose subject is for.subject in for.namespace; the retry spends it once and runs the call with humanPresent set when every field of for equals the retrying caller's and the input digest matches. It holds no text: only the preview's declared properties, which manifest version 5 requires to be in the gated command's journal.keep (ids), and the SHA-256 of the preview the page rendered from the live store. An expired decision keeps status pending past expires and is refused (PERSON_DECISION_EXPIRED at the CLI; over MCP the relay asks again); rows are purged an hour after expiry, with secure_delete. The URL https://<public host><path>/d/<id> holds no identity.

id.description: 128 random bits, unpadded lowercase base32: 26 characters.

for.description: Who the decision is for: from credentials over MCP (the issuer alias and the client id), or from the namespaced principal.local_id at the CLI (issuer and clientId null).

subject.description: The namespaced id's subject part, literal or hashed (4.1).

inputDigest.description: Unpadded base64url SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the validated input (step 0a's amendment).

properties.description: Only the preview's declared properties, at most 16: each it reads as an id (in journal.keep) a string of at most 512 characters with no control character, a number, a boolean or a list of at most 100 such strings, as journal.keep keeps them; each it shows as text (in journal.show, phase 5 step 6: a rejection's reason) a string of at most 2000 characters with no control character but line ends and tabs, held for the decision's life and never journaled.

expires.description: createdAt plus person.decision_ttl_s (600 seconds by default), moved to each render's time plus it, never more than 24 hours after createdAt.

previewHash.description: sha256 of the preview the page rendered; the preview itself is never stored.

pages.description: Each page of the preview the page rendered for this decision, at most 200 (MAX_PREVIEW_PAGES): its number, the SHA-256 of what it showed, and the ids of its items in the order shown. An unpaged preview is one page with no items.

excluded.description: The item ids the person unchecked, at most 2000 (MAX_EXCLUDED), each an id a rendered page listed. Final on Approve.

allOf.description: A decision on the person page records the login: its authTime and acr.
A decision on the local page has no login, and is for the local person: namespace local, no issuer and no client.

actor.description: AFD's Actor; it follows AFD's contract version.

itemId.description: An item's id: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', unique across the decision's pages.
